scope: Development study of one photograph, four previously generated automatic crops and four one-source-pixel translations. No learned model deployment or ground-truth-cut claim. Fresh paired solves use source pixels only. All exported outputs independently rendered and audited, including rejected outputs.

configurationAndCrops.scope: Four previously automatic crops plus one-source-pixel translations of the mixed-model crop. Coordinates fixed before paired fitting. No reference cutting paths.

independentFeatures.method: Both colours; four-connected interior source regions with a solid core. At least 60% of each region must remain its original colour. Regions touching the border or its one-pixel neighbourhood, and tiny or thin classification fragments, are excluded. All observed pixels still enter the image-error measurement.

limitations: Floating-point chord-based intersection checks, not exact algebraic predicates.
Samples on a target cut within twice the geometry tolerance have no unambiguous colour and are counted separately.
Forward image sampling supplements the edge-parity and path-topology checks; it is not an exact area comparison.
Cut-error simulation and paper-core analysis are separate from this nominal validator.

paper.method: Guarded disk-centre lattice on the unfolded capsule. Four-neighbour connectivity; analytic outline and chord-distance refinement near threshold.
limitations: This replaces the Python GEOS offset implementation; numerical results are not identical.
Pass/fail concern this guarded discrete rolling-disk model, not stress or tear resistance.
Uncertain is not accepted by the strict material-core gate. Increase resolution to investigate.
Small tips and features below the explicitly stated area threshold are not certified.
